note: Existing 9 INSEE PCS family (profession.socProcINSEE.famSocPro) sitting-member buckets kept (sum 577). Added 10 INSEE PCS category (profession.socProcINSEE.catSocPro) buckets from the same official AMO10 deputes_actifs JSON (17e, 577 acteurs), cap +10. Category buckets are a finer official INSEE slice of the same 577 sitting members — not additive to the family total, not occupation-of-donor, not campaign-euro. Remaining catSocPro labels beyond the +10 cap were not stored. 3 acteurs had nil catSocPro (same undeclared count as family). INSEE.fr PCS 2003 nomenclature pages confirm the category labels; INSEE.fr does not publish a separate 17e sitting-député occupation table. CNCCFP 2024 législatives dossier de presse / publication simplifiée still has no sitting-only origin-of-receipts euro table: typical ≥5% candidate receipt shares were not converted into euros; named candidate rows on data.gouv were not summed; natural-person donor identities unpublished (code électoral) and were not collected. HATVP DIA/DSP remain ethics-lane. Named private donors not collected. Euro totals not invented.
